language: mixed
targets: service:business_permit, office:bplo
request: "may requirement ba galing ss ibang office lara sa business permit for a new business"

intent: where_to_secure
shape: go_first
variants: applicant_type:new
MATCH (s:Service {id: $sid})-[:REQUIRES]->(r:Requirement)
WHERE NOT EXISTS {
MATCH (r)-[:APPLIES_WHEN]->(v:Variant)
WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (x:Variant) WHERE x.id IN $variant_ids AND x.dimension = v.dimension }
AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (r)-[:APPLIES_WHEN]->(w:Variant) WHERE w.id IN $variant_ids AND w.dimension = v.dimension }
}
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:SATISFIED_BY]->(d:Service)<-[:OFFERS]-(o1:Office)
OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[:SECURED_AT]->(a:Agency)-[:IS_OFFICE]->(o2:Office)
WITH r, d, o1, a, o2
WHERE d IS NOT NULL OR o2 IS NOT NULL
RETURN r.id, r.text, d.name, o1.name, a.name, o2.name
ORDER BY r.id
LIMIT 50
